replicated_originals.reference: Bem, D. J. (2011) Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect (Experiments 8 and 9, retroactive facilitation of recall)

A.reason: PsycEXTRA grey-literature record by Bem (2011) of the same retroactive-influence work under a pre-publication title; the paper cites only the JPSP version, but this is a variant record of the replicated work (Experiments 8 and 9).

B.reason: The abstract and methods state that seven experiments replicate the procedure of Bem (2011) Experiments 8 and 9 (retroactive facilitation of recall); the reference list gives doi:10.1037/a0021524.

notes: Galak, LeBoeuf, Nelson & Simmons (2012). The replicated finding is retroactive facilitation of recall from Bem (2011) Exp 8 and Exp 9. The meta-analysis also pools other labs' replications (Ritchie et al. 2012, etc.), but those are not originals. Candidate A is the PsycEXTRA variant of the same Bem 2011 work, not a distinct study.
